modern: Do Panthea or Fergamus now sit by the tomb of Verus? Do Chaurias or Diotimus sit by the tomb of Hadrianus? That would be ridiculous. Well, suppose they did sit there, would the dead be aware of it? And if the dead were aware, would they be pleased? And if they were pleased, would that make them immortal? Was it not in the order of destiny that these people too should first become old women and old men and then die? What, then, would those others do after these were dead? All this is foul smell and blood in a bag.
